audio.note: Proposed baseline per directive 17.8. Confirm suitability for the intended placement.

calibration.note: Similarity thresholds are placeholders. Calibrate against approved examples and known failures before qualification; store the calibrated thresholds and reviewer procedure here. Do not claim an uncalibrated numeric similarity score proves identity.

cta.note: Final CTA hold at least three seconds; review at 360px-wide mobile rendition within placement safe areas. OCR alone does not prove readability or identity.

lyrics.note: 100% required offer/claim/product/CTA words present and correct. Approved pronunciation mappings may change spelling in generation input, never meaning.

source: directive section 17.8 (baseline specification choices, not claims that provider outputs already pass them)

timeline.note: Round once to declared frame grid, prohibit cumulative drift. No unintended gaps, black frames or missing media.

timing.note: Measured on independently annotated sample lines. Record sample, confidence and annotation method. Low-confidence alignment requires review, never invented precision.

ww_wave.note: Rules added by the WW-PREVENT-RECURRENCE wave (Unit U1, arc-revision-battery). Stored ONCE here; every gate reads this file rather than re-deriving a threshold. All values are NEW ACCEPTANCE CHOICES, not calibrated measurements.

performed_manifest.note: A performed-beat manifest is generated from ONE source for all twelve canonical beats with the lines that must be heard IN ORDER, the delivery, the hook placement and the pace cues. The fifteen-stage source method and the eight coarse timing stages are preserved as explicit NAMED mappings and are never relabelled as one another.

creative_fingerprint.note: Stored with the take and compared against the fingerprinted revision actually submitted; a mismatch refuses the take. An edited later sheet never re-binds an existing take.

overlap.note: Three DISTINCT initial identities are required; duplicate or identical receipts FAIL. 0.999 s (999999 us) FAILS. Local clocks are never admissible and are never backfilled.

parity.note: A release-level parity check compares the same shared core scope between the two copies; a missing canonical source or twin is UNDETERMINED and is never reported as a release PASS.

version.note: The next patch version is read LIVE from main at build time; a bump-only commit is forbidden.
